name: Seed Junky Pre-Roll | Arctic Burst
description: Arctic Burst hits like a rush of frozen flavor—think blue icee slush with a sweet, fruity twist and a crisp pine finish. The cool sensation lingers on your tongue, leaving a refreshing, almost mouthwatering feeling that keeps you coming back. High in flavor and smooth on the exhale, this strain delivers a balanced, uplifting high that keeps you calm, clear, and locked in. It’s a flavorful escape with a frosty edge.
